findings.description: MarketDerivationEngine.derive() does not set match_id on the returned MarketProbabilities object, and service.py does not set market_probs.match_id before calling evaluate_and_select(). SmartMarketSelector reads market_probs.match_id when building BestTip/PassDecision, so the mensione_pick dict will contain match_id=None.
findings.action: Add `market_probs.match_id = match.id` after line 872 (after derive() call) and before line 880 (evaluate_and_select() call).
